taunt: I licked the joystick. Twice.
This scab is older than you.
I peed in the ball pit. Come on in.
I have a permission slip for this. I made it myself.
I jumped the septic tank on a bike. Mostly over it.
My helmet has seven dents. You are dent number eight.
Cardboard armor. Duct tape. Zero fear.
I broke my arm three times this summer. It grew back meaner.
Stitches are just zippers for skin.
I ate a worm for a dollar. I would eat you for free.
I picked my nose and I am keeping it for later.
This booger has a name. His name is Kevin.
I have not washed my hands since the fourth grade.
I sneeze on purpose.
Want to see my scar? Too bad. Here it is.
I drank pond water. I can see sounds now.
My mom signed this. My mom is a crayon.
Detention can wait.
Nobody saw that.
I did a backflip off the garage. The garage lost.
My pogo stick has no brakes and no warranty.
Boing. That is the sound of your doom.
I lit my own eyebrows on fire. On purpose. For science.
I have a frog in my pocket. He is my backup.
I put a whoopee cushion on the principal. Twice. Same day.
My cast has forty signatures. All forged.
Hit me. I dare you. I double dog dare you. With cheese.
I can burp the national anthem. Shut up and listen.
I chewed this gum yesterday. And the day before.
My gum has been in my mouth longer than you have been in this game.
I am grounded. I am grounded in the dirt. On you.
I hold the school record for most trips to the nurse.
The nurse has my picture on her wall. With a big X.
I lost a tooth. I am saving it to throw at you.
I have a loose tooth. Want to see me pull it with a door?
Watch me do a wheelie. On a pogo stick. Nobody has done that.
Nobody has done that because it is impossible. Watch anyway.
My sister is smarter. I am louder.
I put a dead fish in the air vent at school.
The fish is still there. Like a legend.
My armor is from a refrigerator box. It is rated for refrigerators.
Duct tape fixes everything. Except you.
I am the backyard stunt king. Bow down. Watch out for the dog poop.
I stepped in dog poop on purpose. Now I am a weapon.
Smell my sneakers. That is a power move.
My socks can stand up by themselves. They are my army.
I fell off the roof. It was the best day of my life.
Mom says no more stunts. Mom is not here.
I jumped a bike over three kids and a mailbox.
The mailbox did not make it.
I will throw my retainer at you. It is sticky.
This retainer has been in a toilet. Twice.
I eat glue. I eat glue and I am glued to winning.
I am small. I am fast. I am covered in mud.
Neener neener. That is a battle cry.
Your face looks like my science project. The mold one.
My science project grew legs and walked away.
I hit things with sticks. I am a stick-hitting professional.
Bring it. I have nine lives. Seven left.
I have broken every bone. Some of them twice. Some of them were not mine.
I got a gold star once. I ate it.
I can spit farther than you can throw.
Hork. That was a loogie. It went where it needed to go.
I have a permission slip to hit you. Read it. It says yes.
My dad said fight fair. My dad is asleep.
I put a thumbtack on my own chair to toughen up.
I sit on thumbtacks for breakfast.
Ouch is not in my vocabulary. My vocabulary is small.
I flunked spelling. I aced punching.
My tetanus shot is up to date. Is yours?
I found a rusty nail. I am calling it my good luck nail.
I am allergic to baths. Look it up. Do not look it up.
My helmet smells like cheese. The cheese is from inside my head.
I bet I can jump that. I bet I cannot. I am going anyway.
Ready, set, I already went.
Last one down is a rotten egg. I have a rotten egg. Catch.
I keep rotten eggs in my backpack for emergencies.
This is an emergency.
My shorts are blue. My knees are purple. My heart is black.
I pogo through life. Mostly through windows.
I fixed my bike with spaghetti. It held.
I wrote my name on a cop car. It was spelled right this time.
I am a menace. It says so on my report card.
The report card is under the couch. With the cat.
The cat is fine. The cat is my stunt double.
I have a slingshot. I have peas. I have no mercy.
My armor fell off. I am still dangerous. I am more dangerous.
Wedgies build character. I have so much character.
Hey! Look over there! Ha! Made you look! Now I hit you!
I am going to flick your ear so hard.
Wet willy. Prepare yourself.
I am the reason the playground has rules.
The playground has a sign with my face on it.
I jumped off the high dive with no water. I did not know.
I am fine. I am always fine. My elbow is backwards. I am fine.
Sticks and stones break bones. I have fixed them all with tape.
I drink sour milk to toughen my stomach.
My stomach is made of iron and old chili.
Bonk. That was your head. Bonk again.
I fell off my bike so many times the road knows my name.
continue: Stitches are just zippers for skin. Insert coin.
I have been dead before. It is boring. Coin.
That did not count. I was not ready. Coin.
My helmet is cracked. My spirit is not. Quarter.
I forged a continue slip. Just insert the coin.
I have a quarter. It is from a sewer. It still works.
Walk it off. Coin it off.
Put a quarter in or I lick the screen.
One more try. I almost had it. I did not almost have it.
Mom! Mom! I need a quarter! And a bandage! Quarter first!
I broke my leg. Good thing I have two.
Give me the quarter or I tell Mom you hit me.
This is not over. This is a commercial break.
I will be right back. Do not let them touch my pogo stick.
ending: Brat pogoed off the cabinet roof, broke both arms and signed his own casts. He spelled his name wrong both times.
Brat forged a permission slip to leave the cabinet. It worked, which worries everyone.
Brat jumped every pit in 996 games. He is saving the last one for his birthday.
Brat got a gold star from the Baron. He ate it.
Brat started a stunt show in the cabinet. Admission is one quarter. Refunds are not possible. Neither is safety.
Brat broke the world record for most bones broken in one weekend. Then he broke the record.
Brat kept a sewer rat as a pet. The rat is the one who is scared.
Brat taught the Shoe Clan to pogo. The Shoe Clan is now banned from three malls.
Brat buried a time capsule in the cabinet. It has a frog in it. The frog is fine.
Brat finally took a bath. The tub needed three days to recover.
Brat pogoed all the way home. He went through two houses on the way.
Brat got his tenth cast this year. The hospital gave him a punch card.
